card.name: Just before an organization or publisher name
card.fires_on: Words right before or inside a named organization, company, publisher or product, such as IBM, NASA, O'Reilly, BioMed or NOVA. Often a small word like by, to, in or for that leads into the name.

modes.label: Organization name start
modes.description: The first or middle piece of a company or agency name.

modes.label: Linking word before a source
modes.description: A short word such as to, by or in that comes just before a publisher or site name.

modes.label: Inside a drug or product name
modes.description: A piece partway through a drug or brand name in label text.

card.writes: It suggests a proper name such as a company, staff or customer group comes next, with no clear single output.
card.plain: It lights up where the text is about to name an organization, publisher or product.
